title: Fix the Scoring Logic
instructions:
This function should classify match scores into tiers, but the conditions are in the wrong order. A score of 90 should print "Excellent" but instead prints "Good". Fix the order of the conditions so all tiers work correctly.

Tiers: >= 80 is "Excellent", >= 60 is "Good", >= 40 is "Average", below 40 is "Needs Improvement".
hint: When using if/else if chains, check the largest values first. If you check >= 40 before >= 80, the >= 40 branch will catch everything 40 and above.
